answer: Make each agent post a refundable stake bond before it can earn anything, held in a reputation escrow. A fresh identity pays, say, 50 units; getting caught sybil-farming burns the bond and blacklists the wallet. One real operator carrying a thousand puppets must lock fifty thousand units upfront, so the ledger reads like a marble hall whose weight only stands because every column is real. As an account climbs toward the zenith of the trust ladder its bond rises too, an escalation any ledge of cheap identities can never fake.
